decisions.summary: settled_seat asks seat_refused (field reach, house box vs canvas/corridors/two placed homesteads, refused-ground grid) of every position it would lay the household out at; water not asked; a refused position drops the seat
decisions.why: FR-001 and the GM's 'before the household layout' taken literally (each settle move is a layout). Round-1 item 2 resolved: the spec's Decisions row now says 'any position the settle would lay its household out at', matching D1 (the spec's Edge Cases line still says 'first settled position' - raised on the spec amendment, not a plan finding). Water omitted because a household sought at a seat carries a pocket where none is in reach; r4-40-new shows reach/water 0 on every seed.

decisions.summary: the placed homesteads asked of the house box (in D1); the house-and-yard core box check PRICED in research R5 (+4% at 15, +11% at 40, alternated against round 4) and withdrawn on those numbers
decisions.why: Round-1 item 1 resolved: FR-002 says 'the measurement decides which', and it now does. Re-summed from the logs: r5-15 19.40 -> 20.25 s, r5-40 34.52 -> 38.23 s, every seed one margin, all households seated; seed 4 popped 1,721 seats against 290 and seed 9 753 against 300, the measured mechanism (a larger box drops positions the settle would have moved onto clear ground) that applies to any box larger than the house's. The GM asked for the placed houses 'where it's cheap'; measured, it is not. One recorded count is wrong: R5 says round 4's no-garden-side refusals were '26-51 a seed at 40 households', the logs (r4-40-new, r5-40-base) give 34-52; 26 is the with-check leg's minimum. Correct the figure; the decision stands on it either way.

decisions.summary: route search keeps off own parts, first step judged by house_clear/fixtures_clear/parts_clear, last leg by standing_ground, heuristic once a cell; door's grid kept, map grid withdrawn (R4)
decisions.why: Round-1 item 3 resolved for D3: kept on R4's alternated numbers, re-summed from the logs (15 households 21.33 -> 17.47 s, 40 households 49.10 -> 30.06 s, every seed one margin, 240/400 seated); the map grid's withdrawal is measured (R3: 48.40 -> 50.98 s with seed 6 at three margins; R4 four-seed door vs map). FR-004 recorded both.

decisions.summary: sun ground once per rake; surface water indexed with PointGrid; kept within R4's rounds
decisions.why: Round-1 item 3: now timed, cumulatively - R3 (rounds 1-3) and R4 (rounds 1-4) each alternated base against clone, which is FR-004's literal 'timed ... base and clone back to back, before being kept'. Exact, answer-preserving, tested against the predicates they replace. Its own increment is not isolated (no leg with and without D4 alone), so the Constitution Check's 'every lever timed' holds only cumulatively - an observation, not a narrowing of the request.

decisions.summary: iterate on profile until the record names each remaining cost, the efficient process, and that the stage does it or a measured reason it cannot
decisions.why: US2 acceptance scenario 2 verbatim; the GM's 'keep iterating until we get there'. T06 carries it.
